extDescription.message: Copy a product title and clean product URL in one click.

appSubtitle.message: Copy product title and clean URL in one click

floatingEnabledDesc.message: Show a copy button on supported product pages.

floatingPositionDesc.message: Drag the button on a product page. Its position is saved automatically.

showNotificationDesc.message: Display a short message after a successful copy.

notificationDurationDesc.message: How long the confirmation stays visible.

websitesDesc.message: Enable or disable each website independently.

appendBlankLines.message: Add blank lines after copied URL

appendBlankLinesDesc.message: Append two line breaks after the URL. Enabled by default.

includeStoreSource.message: Add store source before product title

includeStoreSourceDesc.message: Prefix the product title with the store name, for example [PChome 24h]. Enabled by default.
